about: Reference case: FNO's synthetic patient 10 (data/rakathon-26), the case the demo is built on

expectations.about: The MRI finding was sent to the neurosurgical seminar; the seminar's result is not in the documents
The request without a result raises the request_without_result alert
The outpatient report of page 1 quotes the brain MR of 14.9.2026 done at NNJ; its radiology report is not in the documents
expectations.known_failure: The extraction (extract-facts-cs@5) marks the quoted MR as reported_as original, so the case rule sees an original report. Fix in the extraction prompt or its checks (stream D, #20), not in the rule.

expectations.about: The pathological stage at diagnosis (2.6.2022) is the only stage: no stage contradiction
Patient 10's lab sheet prints no draw date: no lab value gets a date
